Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the supply of water by public utility districts bordered by the Columbia river to be used in, or power from, pumped storage projects.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the supply of water by public utility districtsbordered by the Columbia river to be used in, or power from, pumpedstorage projects; adding a new section to chapter 54.16 RCW; anddeclaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 54.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Notwithstanding any other provision of this chapter to thecontrary, a public utility district bordered by the Columbia river maysupply any electric energy from a pumped storage generating facility orwater under its control to be used in a pumped storage generatingfacility to any entity that sells electric energy or water, directly orindirectly, to the public, and contracts therefor must extend over theperiod of years and contain the terms and conditions for the salethereof as the commission of the public utility district elects. Sucha contract may only be made pursuant to resolution of the commissionauthorizing such a contract, and the resolution must be introduced ata meeting of the commission at least ten days prior to the date of the p. 1 SB 6044adoption of the resolution. However, the commission shall first makeadequate provision for the needs of the public utility district, bothactual and prospective.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
